items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Christ was asked why he spoke so much like Elijah. He said, “I am Elijah.” Than can only mean one thing. He’s a reincarnation of Elijah.

ctx.x: Accepted it. He was okay. He didn’t see any reference to astrology in there, because it was hidden. And so was reincarnation. The only references to reincarnation are made in direct speech. Christ was asked why he spoke so much like Elijah. He said, “I am Elijah.” Than can only mean one thing. He’s a reincarnation of Elijah.
I’ve never heard of this before.
